> FIRST: if its only .changeset rows are CHANGED, not added, this PR corrects somebody else's pending release note -- do NOT apply 'skip-changeset'; write the confirmation on the PR … and leave this check red (#18375). Otherwise, if it releases nothing …, apply the 'skip-changeset' label

This PR has **no `.changeset` rows at all** — the diff is one file, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` — so it is the second branch, ⛔ not the first.

⭐ **The 「releases nothing」 premise was measured, ⛔ not assumed**, because `files[]` does not decide what ships:

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| `content/` a `pnpm-workspace.yaml` member | **no** (members are `packages/*`, `apps/*`, `examples/*`, …) |
| any package `files[]` naming `content/` | **0** — with a lit control (`packages/cli` reads `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`) proving the instrument reads `files[]` at all, so the zero is a reading |

⚠️ **This is ⛔ NOT the case batch #156 item 1 ruled on.** That ruling's 「⛔ No seat applies that label on its own authority again」 attaches to the branch above it: a PR **correcting a pending release note**, where the label would exempt the whole `changeset-check` job and the red is the gate asking for a human release decision. Read at source (`5725677335`) rather than from a paraphrase. PR #18867 is that case and stays red and parked; this PR is not.

Re-read after the write: label present (`documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`) — ⚠️ checked deliberately, because `pr-automation.yml` records the size labeler's `PUT` stripping this exact label one second after a confirmed read-back. `Check Changeset` re-ran at 03:28:51Z and reports **skipped**.

⛔ The PR stays **draft**; this clears one red and is not a landing judgement. Its dev is still running and owes the terminal report.
